parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'now', now(),
  'session', (
    SELECT json_build_object('session_id', session_id, 'open_at', open_at, 'close_at', close_at, 'early_close', early_close)
    FROM intraday.session_manifests
    WHERE trade_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date
    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  ),
  'health', (
    SELECT coalesce(json_agg(h), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (source) source, checked_at,
             round(extract(epoch FROM now() - checked_at)::numeric, 1) AS checked_age_s,
             provider_age_s, http_failures, missing_symbols, status, last_success_at
      FROM intraday.source_health
      WHERE checked_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
      ORDER BY source, checked_at DESC
    ) h
  ),
  'newest_bar', (
    SELECT json_build_object('bar_end', max(bar_end),
           'age_s', round(extract(epoch FROM now() - max(bar_end))::numeric, 1))
    FROM intraday.bar_versions WHERE bar_end > now() - interval '1 day'
  ),
  'jobs', (
    SELECT coalesce(json_agg(j), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT workflow, source, status, lease_owner,
             round(extract(epoch FROM now() - lease_expires)::numeric, 1) AS lease_overdue_s, attempts
      FROM intraday.ingestion_jobs WHERE status IN ('claimed','pending','failed')
    ) j
  ),
  'open_incidents', (
    SELECT coalesce(json_agg(i), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT id, kind, detail->>'sig' AS sig FROM intraday.incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL
    ) i
  )
) AS status;

parameters.content:
## Trigger

Every minute. Self-gates: raises incidents only inside an expected session window (a WF-01 manifest exists, now within OPEN-30m..CLOSE+15m). Quiet otherwise.

## Read status

One read-only query builds a status object: latest source_health per source, newest bar age, open jobs and lease, today's manifest, open-incident sigs.

## Evaluate + apply

Thresholds: heartbeat >180s, provider age >120s, http failures, outage, bar gap >180s, overdue lease. Each problem carries a stable sig; new sigs open an incident, cleared sigs resolve. Deduped by open sig, no messaging.

## Workflow errors

Error Trigger. Registered as the errorWorkflow for the intraday collectors; each failed run appends a workflow_error incident with the node and message.
